title: What's New: Enhanced Sales Analytics (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Customer Retention Overview and History Reports
Improved Sales Reports and Analysis Views

features.name: Customer Retention Overview and History Reports
features.description: Two new reports in the Power BI app for sales that allow you to see whether customers are recurring, churning, or returning, viewable by geography or customer. Includes historical representation showing new recurring customers over time, temporary lost customers, and real lost customers.

features.name: ABC Analysis Report
features.description: A new report that allows you to divide your inventory of items into categories A, B, and C based on sales volume. Useful for sales analysis to identify top-selling items and can be used in both Power BI and Excel formats.
caveats: Primarily an inventory feature but has sales analysis applications

features.name: Pivot Table Subtotals for Sales Reports
features.description: Five sales reports shipped in fall 2025 are being updated with pivot table subtotals. The initial version missed subtotals in the pivot tables, which is now being added as a simple enhancement.

features.name: Analysis Views Shipping with AL Apps
features.description: New ability to ship analysis tabs or analysis views with AL apps or AL code. Out of the box analysis views are being added to the sales order list.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this release wave we are adding the ability to ship analysis tabs or analysis views with the with with AL apps
caveats: Three analysis views on sales order list coming in 28.x, not in the April release

features.name: Enhanced Sales Demo Data
features.description: Extended and enhanced demo data for sales that includes the number of open sales orders and back orders as well as data distribution to enable better data stories in sales demonstrations.
